scenes.narration: Most AI agent demos stop at a chat box. What I care about is the opposite — a production system with routing, tools, gates, and hosts.
scenes.headline: Not a chat box

visual.text: A production system: routing, tools, gates, hosts

scenes.narration: Think factory floor, not chatbot. Work arrives, and an orchestrator assigns specialist agents to it — planner, coder, search.
scenes.headline: Factory floor, not chatbot

scenes.narration: They work through shared skills and tools, and they retrieve from real sources rather than inventing from nothing.
scenes.headline: Skills, tools, retrieval

visual.text: Shared craft library — not invention from nothing

scenes.narration: Eval gates then check the result — tests, policy, claim safety. They fail closed before anything merges. Green is not theater.
scenes.headline: Green is not theater

scenes.narration: And a human still owns the irreversible moves — force pushes, secrets, infrastructure where the blast radius is real.
scenes.headline: Human approval

scenes.narration: Docker and Azure host the runtime — twenty plus production containers on a homelab I operate — and dashboards show status.
scenes.headline: Docker · Azure · dashboards

visual.text: 20+ production containers on a homelab I operate

scenes.narration: The practices matter more than model choice. Verification before trust. Claim safety, so numbers stay tied to evidence. And when something burns, the fix goes into policy and gates.
scenes.headline: Practices over model choice

visual.text: Verification before trust · claim safety · fail-closed defaults

scenes.narration: That's the thesis. Agents move the work; controls keep it real.
scenes.headline: Agents move work. Controls keep it real.
